title: A Machine-Checked Itô Calculus for Brownian Motion
summary: We develop the Itô calculus of Brownian motion, machine-checked in Lean~4 over Mathlib and the \lean{BrownianMotion} package. On a bounded interval $[0,T]$ the Itô integral is built as a Hilbert-space isometry, from a predictable-rectangle $π$-system through the density of simple adapted processes. Realized as a process, it is a continuous $L^2$ martingale.
